title: Coordinated Behavior in Information Operations on Twitter
strengths: Establishes multi-channel coordination network analysis on real election campaigns
limitations: Relies on fixed heuristic thresholds; does not evaluate LLM paraphrasing or GNNs
relevance_to_our_work: Direct benchmark dataset and baseline formulation for our study

title: Labeled Datasets for Research on Information Operations
primary_dataset: Zenodo IO corpus (Honduras, UAE, China, etc.)
strengths: Provides verified IO and control accounts with full provenance
limitations: Does not propose a unified adversarial detection architecture
relevance_to_our_work: Primary ground-truth dataset provenance for our empirical experiments

title: Uncovering Coordinated Networks on Social Media
strengths: Foundational formulation of latent coordination graphs from shared actions
limitations: Focuses primarily on exact URL and retweet sharing; vulnerable to content rewrite
relevance_to_our_work: Theoretical foundation of latent coordination graph projection

title: It Takes a Village to Manipulate the Media: Coordinated Link Sharing Behavior
strengths: Introduces time-thresholded co-sharing for coordinated link diffusion
limitations: Limited strictly to uniform URL sharing; blind to semantic text coordination
relevance_to_our_work: Inspired our exponential temporal decay score formulation

title: Coordinated Behavior on Social Media: A Survey
venue: IEEE Transactions on Computational Social Systems
strengths: Categorizes coordination into content, temporal, network, and multi-modal layers
limitations: Conducted prior to the widespread deployment of generative LLMs for evasion
relevance_to_our_work: Defines the taxonomical foundation of our 6-signal multi-modal edge feature set

title: TwiBot-22: Towards Graph-Based Twitter Bot Detection
method_family: GNNs (R-GCN, GraphSAGE) over heterogeneous follower graphs
strengths: Establishes large-scale graph learning over user relationship networks
limitations: Follower graphs require API access and fail when bot accounts do not follow each other
relevance_to_our_work: Demonstrates GNN superiority; we adapt GNNs to latent coordination graphs rather than follower graphs

title: Graph Neural Networks for Detecting Online Inauthentic Behavior
strengths: Learns representation over heterogeneous user-post graphs
limitations: Heavy memory requirement; does not test against automated LLM paraphrase attacks
relevance_to_our_work: Validates graph representation learning for malicious user detection

title: Sentence-BERT: Sentence Embeddings using Siamese BERT-Networks
strengths: Enables massive-scale vector similarity search via dense embedding indexing
limitations: Bi-encoders suffer from information bottleneck on fine-grained semantic nuances
relevance_to_our_work: Forms Stage 1 of our retrieve-then-rerank architecture

title: DeBERTaV3: Improving DeBERTa using ELECTRA-Style Pre-Training
strengths: State-of-the-art cross-attention between token pairs for precise entailment
limitations: Quadratic compute complexity prevents all-pairs cross-attention at scale
relevance_to_our_work: Forms Stage 2 precision reranker over our FAISS candidate dyads

title: Inductive Representation Learning on Large Graphs (GraphSAGE)
strengths: Scalable spatial neighborhood aggregation capable of generalizing across graphs
relevance_to_our_work: Our winning supervised model (F1=0.962, ROC-AUC=0.988 on Honduras)

title: Graph-Convolutional Networks for Account Classification on Social Media
strengths: Validates node classification on interaction graphs over standalone tabular features
limitations: Tested on static historical archives without adversarial evasion
relevance_to_our_work: Directly motivates our comparison between tabular RF and relational GNNs

title: The Rise of Social Bots
strengths: Pioneered behavioral feature extraction (follower ratios, posting rates)
limitations: Isolated account classifiers are easily defeated by human-operated or hybrid cyborg accounts
relevance_to_our_work: Forms the tabular baseline baseline that we prove is vulnerable to profile memorization
